data.one_liner: Type-safe external deeplinks into apps with automatic store and web fallbacks
data.what_it_does: Allows you to launch external apps or specific screens inside them from your Flutter application using strongly-typed Dart calls. It automatically handles checking app installation and falling back to the appropriate app store or web URL when the target app is missing.
use_when: You need to deep-link users out of your app into external applications like WhatsApp, Telegram, or YouTube.
You want to open maps, search places, or trigger turn-by-turn navigation across multiple providers with fallback handling.
You want to programmatically redirect users to specific app store listings across multiple platforms without writing platform checks.
avoid_when: You are trying to handle incoming deep links or universal links into your own app.
You need raw URL string manipulation without type-safe action definitions.
strengths: Strongly-typed API for 42+ apps and navigation providers.
Smart three-tier fallback mechanism (native app -> app store -> web).
Built-in installation checking before launching apps.
Cross-platform support spanning iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration like query schemes in Info.plist and package visibility in AndroidManifest.xml.
Built for external app launching, so it does not solve inbound routing needs.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding query schemes in ios/Runner/Info.plist and package visibility tags in android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml for the apps you target.

alternatives.name: flutter_custom_tabs
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to open web links inside customized in-app browser tabs rather than launching external installed apps.
